description: This file declares the ScreenCapture plugin class within the WPEFramework, including conditional compilation for different platform-specific screencapture implementations, external dependencies, and related structures. It contains class definitions, method declarations, and preprocessor directives related to screenshot capturing functionality in a plugin architecture.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Main plugin class handling screencapture operations, inheriting JSONRPC and plugin interfaces, with platform-specific methods and internal state management.

classes.name: ScreenCaptureStore
classes.description: Conditional struct used to store and process screen capture data on AML platform.

classes.name: ScreenShotJob
classes.description: Class used for scheduling or managing screenshot jobs on non-AML platforms.

methods.name: uploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Handles uploading of screenshot data via JSON-RPC method.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
